source: We noticed that beauty YouTubers have a curiously large share of the shame pie.

source: We compare their daily total subscribers to their pre-controversy max. As expected, nearly all channels were making gains.
claim: 32 of the 34 channels had a higher normalized subscriber value at the end of the pre-controversy period than at its start.

source: Steeper lines means faster growth. Jake Paul (not a beauty vlogger) doubled his subscribers in the three months prior to his controversy.
claim: Jake Paul's normalized subscriber value on day 1, the last day before the controversy, is 2.07 times its value on day 90.
